question: Approve this design to enter implementation? Cycle 3 closes the recovery-procedure gap from the Subspace review with a verified (spiked, not asserted) per-phase recovery procedure.

artifacts.summary: Cycle 3 closes the gap the Subspace review found: the design now states, and spike-verifies against a real broken-origin fixture, exactly what the FO runs after a mid-ceremony sync failure -- standalone state commit <slug> publishes whatever a failed gate verb left locally committed but unpushed, for either phase (record or consume), after which the lifecycle's existing Resume discipline picks the next verb. Non-re-entrancy of the composite is demonstrated, not assumed: a repeat gate record refuses frozen-closed, a repeat gate consume refuses byte-clean as already-consumed. One design refinement fell out of the spike: sync now runs only when the verb actually wrote, keeping refusal diagnostics side-effect-free. Doc diff and AC-2 updated to cover recovery.
